title: Glowing avocado
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='glow' cx='50%' cy='55%' r='50%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ffffaa' stop-opacity='1'/>
      <stop offset='60%' stop-color='#bbff44' stop-opacity='0.8'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#44aa00' stop-opacity='0'/>
    </radialGradient>
    <radialGradient id='pitGlow' cx='50%' cy='50%' r='50%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ffe8a0'/>
      <stop offset='70%' stop-color='#cc8800'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#885500'/>
    </radialGradient>
  </defs>
  <!-- outer glow halo -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='58' rx='42' ry='38' fill='url(#glow)' opacity='0.45'/>
  <!-- avocado outer skin -->
  <path d='M50 12 C30 12 16 35 16 55 C16 75 30 90 50 90 C70 90 84 75 84 55 C84 35 70 12 50 12 Z' fill='#2d5a1a'/>
  <!-- skin highlight edge -->
  <path d='M50 12 C30 12 16 35 16 55 C16 75 30 90 50 90 C70 90 84 75 84 55 C84 35 70 12 50 12 Z' fill='none' stroke='#4a8a2a' stroke-width='2'/>
  <!-- inner flesh -->
  <path d='M50 20 C34 20 23 39 23 56 C23 73 34 85 50 85 C66 85 77 73 77 56 C77 39 66 20 50 20 Z' fill='#aadd33'/>
  <!-- bright inner flesh glow -->
  <path d='M50 24 C36 24 26 41 26 56 C26 71 36 82 50 82 C64 82 74 71 74 56 C74 41 64 24 50 24 Z' fill='#c8f050'/>
  <!-- soft radial light in flesh -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='52' rx='20' ry='22' fill='#e8ff88' opacity='0.5'/>
  <!-- pit -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='58' rx='13' ry='14' fill='url(#pitGlow)'/>
  <!-- pit shine -->
  <ellipse cx='46' cy='53' rx='5' ry='4' fill='#fff5cc' opacity='0.6'/>
  <!-- little sparkles / glow flecks -->
  <circle cx='30' cy='40' r='1.5' fill='#ffffaa' opacity='0.9'/>
  <circle cx='70' cy='42' r='1.2' fill='#ffffaa' opacity='0.8'/>
  <circle cx='36' cy='70' r='1' fill='#ffffaa' opacity='0.7'/>
  <circle cx='64' cy='73' r='1.3' fill='#ffffaa' opacity='0.8'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='28' r='1.5' fill='#ffffcc' opacity='0.9'/>
  <!-- cute face on the pit -->
  <circle cx='45' cy='56' r='1.8' fill='#663300'/>
  <circle cx='55' cy='56' r='1.8' fill='#663300'/>
  <circle cx='45.5' cy='55.2' r='0.7' fill='#ffeeaa' opacity='0.8'/>
  <circle cx='55.5' cy='55.2' r='0.7' fill='#ffeeaa' opacity='0.8'/>
  <path d='M46 63 Q50 67 54 63' fill='none' stroke='#663300' stroke-width='1.4' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- blush -->
  <ellipse cx='40' cy='61' rx='3' ry='1.8' fill='#ff9966' opacity='0.5'/>
  <ellipse cx='60' cy='61' rx='3' ry='1.8' fill='#ff9966' opacity='0.5'/>
</svg>
